log.msg: REAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED, caught by measuring, not by reading the code: `.ai2-detail:has(> .page.active-page) > .ai2-empty { display: none; }` only tested `.active-page`. A card page stays MOUNTED but becomes `.active-ancestor` (not `.active-page`) the instant a sub-card opens in the THIRD column -- a different container (`.ai2-sub`) entirely, so the card is neither the true leaf nor a same-container sibling of one. The rule stopped matching, `.ai2-empty` ('Pick something on the left') reappeared above the still-mounted card page, and pushed its whole content down by its own rendered height -- measured: the detail column's title row at y 45px before opening a sub-card, y 130px after, with every field of the rendered content byte-identical (only the position moved). Fixed with `:is(.active-page, .active-ancestor)`, the arrangement contract's own words for 'is any of this mine' (core/Page/Page.css uses the same pattern repeatedly). This is exactly deliverable 6's own 'nothing above the fold moves when a sub-card opens' requirement, proven headless before AND after the fix (failing, then passing).

SECOND REAL BUG, in my own PROOF HARNESS not the product: a scratch Servex-substitute process survived three rounds of `pkill -f` because git-bash's own PID ($!, and pkill's own view) is NOT the real Windows PID under MSYS -- exactly the trap the minion skill names but I re-learned it the hard way. The stale process kept an open write-stream handle cached against an EARLIER incarnation of the scratch log file; every `rm -rf` + re-migrate created a fresh file at the same path but the stale process's Log.files Map never re-opened it, so writes through it silently vanished (200 ok:true returned, nothing ever landed on disk) while reads against the NEW file correctly showed nothing. `netstat -ano | grep LISTENING` for the real PID, `taskkill //F //PID <n>`, fixed it -- confirms this is my own test infrastructure, not Servex or Log.js, which is unchanged in this regard.

DELIVERABLES 2-4 PROVEN, headless, 27/27 checks green at both 1280 and 400, against a scratch Servex substitute (Log.js + Stream.js, real and unmodified) seeded by migrate-cards.mjs from real historical data (board.jsonl + the real Servex prompts log, read-only) -- never the live board, never the real Servex on 8090/8090. Card topic-mudfqn8c (5 said- sub-cards from its migrated prompts). Proven: cold deep link to a card works; the table of contents renders (5-6 rows depending on width's own timing); clicking a row navigates to /framework/ai2/<slug>/<sub>/ and opens the third column (grid grows to 3 tracks at 1280; one-screen-at-a-time at 400); nothing above the fold in the detail column moves when the sub-card opens (post-fix); talking into the sub-card's own composer posts to BOTH /log/prompts (unchanged, keeps the assistant hearing it) and /log/cards/<slug> with `re: '<slug>/<sub>'` intact, and the entry is readable back from the per-card log; the back link returns to the card's own url and the third column closes; the footer measures 64-70px tall (was ~180px+ combining the old fixed 5.5em script plus its own composer); exactly one region actually scrolls (the rail) at both widths -- the outer `.pages` gutter and `.ai2-detail`'s own scroll are both gone.

assign.outcome: **Per-card storage, sub-cards in a third column, and the footer/scrollbar fix are built and proven — all committed on the worktree branch for the mastermind to merge.** [`migrate-cards.mjs`](/framework/ai2/doc/persistence.md) folds `ai/board.jsonl` plus Servex's `prompts` log through Servex's own single-writer `Log` into one file per card — proven against this worktree's real data: **166 cards, 423 events in, 423 events out, counts agree**. A card's own page now shows a table of contents of its own tasks, proposals, readings and transcript paragraphs, read off its own `cards/<slug>` log; clicking a row opens it beside the card in a real third column at its own address, for example `/framework/ai2/topic-mudfqn8c/said-p-123/`, with a back link that closes it again. Talking into a card or a sub-card now writes to both the fast assistant's inbox (unchanged) and its own durable Servex log, a sub-card's sentence carrying `re: "<slug>/<sub>"`. The footer shrank from roughly 180px to 64–70px and the double scrollbar is down to one; a real bug — the empty-state box silently reappearing under a still-open card the moment a sub-card made it `.active-ancestor`, pushing everything down 85px — was found only by measuring and is fixed. Left deliberately: items 7, 13, 14 and 16 deferred again, each with its own blocker logged in [the decisions doc](/framework/ai2/doc/decisions.md); item 11 (no split sentences) turned out to need `ux/Dictate`, which this task's own fence excludes, so it is flagged for its own task rather than built out of bounds.

decision.topic: how the overview and the rail+detail view coexist
decision.question: Two full layouts at one url -- toggle by url/query param (content()-time, one-shot) or by a live DOM/CSS signal?
options: a query param (?inbox) checked once in content(), matching ai/page.js's own v1() pattern
both views built unconditionally in content(); CSS :has() plus a plain class toggle decide which paints, off the Router's own marks
decision.why: content() runs once, before the Router necessarily knows the deep target -- ai/page.js's own comments document fixing that exact race twice (a cold load vs a same-tab click landing here for the first time). A card's deep link also needs $detail/$sub to exist regardless of which view was 'current' when content() ran, so both had to be built unconditionally anyway -- once that's true, CSS deciding paint is strictly simpler than JS deciding what to build.

log.msg: Built: ai2/overview.js (new) -- column() is one generic stable-list widget (new arrival waits behind a pill, exact same mechanism the rail already used) instantiated 4x: needs-you (flagged + blocked, a clear control per row -- flagged calls the real unflag, a bare blocked item dismisses locally via localStorage since there is no server-side 'clear a blocked task' yet), reports (Note: cards, newest first), landed (task landings), live (Servex's /agents registry -- polled, cors-enabled, NOT /api/agents which has no cors and is silently refused cross-origin; the three usage bars from /framework/ai/usage.json; the last few 'agent' SSE events off the SAME EventSource inbox.js already has open for prompts/cards, a second addEventListener not a second connection). needs-you/reports/landed all read the ONE list board()'s own paint() already computes (page.js gained on_list(fn), one hook, no second data pipeline).

page.js: content() now wraps board()+overview() in one .ai2-shell (display:contents, so the grid math is unaffected); board(page,$outer) gained a second param so the rail's new '<- overview' button can flip the manual toggle class off and navigate home. ai2.css: two selectors (.page.full:has(> .ai2), .page:has(> .ai2) > .page-title) had their '>' dropped to keep matching through the new wrapper; the visibility switch is .ai2-shell.ai2-mode-inbox / :has(.ai2-detail > .page:is(.active-page,.active-ancestor)) deciding .ai2-overview vs .ai2, the same :is() idiom the empty-state fix used last round.
